title: bromus hordeaceus subsp. jansenii
intro: Bromus hordeaceus subsp. jansenii, commonly known as Jansen's Brome, is a subspecies of grass in the family Poaceae. Jansen's Brome is used in traditional medicine and is believed to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Jansen's Brome include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Jansen's Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
